changelog:
- Light Theme Polish: Feature Hub icon circles now use a clean light (#F1F5F9) background with subtle border in light mode instead of dark circles.
- System Nav Bar: Device bottom navigation bar now correctly turns white in light mode and dark in dark mode.
- Live Briefing Light Theme: Comprehensive CSS overrides for all pulse screen elements (segments, news cards, weather card, section headers, back button, publisher meta) now render correctly in light mode.
- Home Background Fix: Explicitly clears dark radial gradient in light mode to ensure the pearl white (#F8FAFC) background is always applied.
- Profile Avatar: Light rounded background applied to the profile avatar in the browser menu when in light mode.
- Fokk AI Accuracy: Improved system prompt to never dismiss real-world incidents (e.g. the Modi 'shall we move?' photo-op moment) when live web sources describe the event.
